top_choice_rationale: Optical lattice clocks (Katori and Ye) are a mature, independently reproduced measurement advance: magic-wavelength trapping of many atoms gives 10^-18 stability, with millimetre-scale gravitational redshift resolved and several laboratories agreeing. The invention and the realization are decisive and cleanly credited to two laureates, with a citation scope distinct from the 2005 comb and 2012 ion prizes. Awarding it is better than no award.
